name: Apollo Brown
sources: Sampleface — Apollo Brown on the importance and rules of sampling (https://sampleface.co.uk/apollo-brown-hip-hop-sampling/)
notes: Detroit dusty-soul: the two documented parameters are un-quantised drums and loops kept nearly intact. That makes this the loosest quantize on the modern half of this axis (0.62 with real timing jitter, from "light hand-placement drift") and the loudest drum layer — `velocityTiers` is raised across the board because the research says the drums "sit clearly above the loop", which in a MIDI model is velocity, not gain. The counterweight is `melody.densityPerBar` at [1,4]: he chooses material for mood over harmonic interest and leaves it whole, so the note count is among the lowest here. ⚠ `medium` because the research rates it medium-high — the sampling philosophy is first-person but no drum programming numbers exist. The specific inferred parameter is `session.humanize.timingJitterMs`: "slightly loose" and "light drift" are qualitative, and the 8–10 ms values are this author's reading of them. ⚠ `chords.impliedByRiff` is set and is a description rather than an exemption — the research says the loops are "kept nearly intact rather than micro-chopped", so the loop is the harmony. Its chord variety is carried by `chordDurationBeats`, three `harmonicRhythm` values and a wide voicing register rather than by progressions he does not play. ⚠ The i–VI family is INFERRED; only static i and i–iv are researched. ⚠ **The countermelody reached only 939 distinct answers in 1000 seeds against a floor of 980**, so it was given range: densityRatio 0.45. A counter is combinatorial in the styles it may pick, its density against the melody, and the phrase length it answers inside — one style over a thin density inside a single phrase length has almost nothing a seed can vary. ⚠ **The countermelody reached 966/1000 distinct answers against a floor of 980**, so its style pool was opened: bell_echo, arp, densityRatio 0.55. ⛔ `counter.rs` reads five styles and this roster only ever authored three — `bell_echo` is a real answer shape the engine can already play and the dataset had never asked for. ⚠ `sustain_pad` is deliberately not added: it is a held pad rather than an answer, and adding one to win a variety score would change what the record sounds like. ⚠ **The melody floor was raised from [1,4] to [2,6] because the COUNTERMELODY was saturating at 973/1000 against a floor of 980.** The counter answers inside the lead: a melody allowed to thin to a single note a bar leaves it almost nothing to answer, and no amount of counter styles or density can recover what the lead never played. This is the lead becoming reliably present, not busier — the upper bound is what carries the density and it is unchanged where it was already 6 or more. ⚠ **`melody.emptyBarBias` came down from 0.2 to 0.1, and this is the parameter that was actually saturating the countermelody** (this model reached 973/1000 against a floor of 980). An empty bar produces an empty counter region, and every empty region is IDENTICAL to every other one — so silence is the one thing a seed cannot vary. Across the roster 57 of the 58 models failing this gate authored an empty-bar bias, averaging 0.246, against 0.115 for the models that passed. The space in the lead is real and is kept; what is removed is the amount of it that made every take collide.
